title: Stored x-only leaf birthday search on secp256k1 at 124.534495156618070: ae21db39 plus proof.md section 9's changes 20-32 (key-path tree to the widened hop-1 cap)

claims.statement: For uniform production secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the classical cold grouped stored-leaf birthday search of proof.md recovers x with probability at least 0.39 over the challenge and fresh algorithm coins (Chen-Stein on cross-node leaf pairs; drops, caps, wrong class indices, label errors, the carry sites of section 3.4 and the fixup meter's cap are charged failure rows; success.md). Its expected total work is at most 2^124.534495156618070 target-group-operation equivalents (1000 AArch64 instructions per unit; at most 223.0163 per leaf), E-averaged over 160 X-groups (group g ending at q1*(g/160)^(21/32), rounded down) that stop at the first resolving group, with every walk, key path, main-pair K2 verification and defect row charged by history-conditional domination (success.md 6.6); the worst case on every run, 2^188.604756 instructions, is disclosed. Six leaves x(phi^t(X) +- Y) per batched inverse of y_Y^2 - y_X^2 are labelled by 128-bit truncated fraction products of their Fourier components (sections 3.1-3.3; bwd 1230.25 and keys 138.5 instructions per pair); records travel two hops in 256-record blocks and join by hash chains at hop-2 arrival (sections 2, 4); every delivery is charged as executed code, with FEAT_LS64 64-byte LD64B/ST64B moving two records at a time between the link window (Device) and R2 (Normal Non-cacheable); hash heads are zeroed by DC ZVA on 256-byte blocks (DCZID_EL0.BS = 6). Peak memory at most 2^135.9990 bytes; preprocessing at most 2^116.1108 units, included; no advice; certificate.py checks every declared figure. soispoke ae21db39 (124.553210294878063, declared dependency) plus the changes 20-32 of proof.md section 9 (credits there; soispoke 45552a5c and Phoenix0075 900bc1be declared); no prior acceptance or score is a premise. An analytic bound, not a practical break.

experiments.purpose: Leaf kernels on production points against bit-exact models of bwd and keys (fractions, bounds, Fourier identity, records, indices, labels); class tests; both hops and the join on a 4 x 4 machine (machine.py, grouped_paths); the 3.4 sites and fixups (sites.py); every kernel count against certificate.py, which it runs. Budget-limited parts run stated minimums. Not a production-scale attack.
